articles.title: Delhi HC voids visa, passport services tender for Australia, Singapore
articles.description: Delhi High Court has set aside the government's tender for outsourcing passport, visa and consular services in Australia, Singapore, the UAE and Kuwait, directing authorities to invite fresh bids

articles.title: Singapore ministry explores using tech to keep closer watch on abused children after they return home
articles.description: A tender put up on July 6 by Singapore's Ministry of Social and Family Development (MSF) is seeking technological solutions to detect physiological and environmental indicators signalling a child may be at higher risk of harm, and alert trusted adults to intervene quickly.

articles.title: Hyderabad’s Ageing Streetlights Leave Large Parts of City in Darkness
articles.description:

However, a fresh maintenance contract is still pending, delaying replacement and repair works across the city. A Greater Hyderabad Municipal Corporation (GHMC) survey found that most of the city's ageing lighting infrastructure now needs replacement. Yet, the operation and maintenance tender has not been floated, even though the state government approved administrative sanction four months ago. The proposed ₹1,341-crore contract covers the maintenance of 7.6 lakh LED streetlights across the three municipal corporations for the next 10 years.

Tender Delay Stalls Repairs

The delay has slowed repair work across Hyderabad. Civic officials have been occupied with the Special Intensive Revision (SIR) exercise and the proposed Core Urban Region (Integrated Governance) Bill. Residents across several neighbourhoods say the problem is becoming more visible. In the IT corridor, including Kondapur, Osman Nagar, Tellapur and Nanakramguda, residents estimate that nearly 30% of streetlights are not working. In Banjara Hills Road No. 12, Goshamahal and MLA Colony, locals say more than half the streetlights are either defunct or provide poor lighting.

No Maintenance Agency for Over a Year

Maintenance has become increasingly difficult since the contract with Energy Efficiency Services Limited (EESL) expired more than a year ago. Without a dedicated maintenance agency, GHMC faces shortages of LED fittings, drivers and CCMS components. A lack of manpower has further delayed repair work. "We will float a fresh tender within the next few days. Although it was originally scheduled for June, the process got delayed. There will be no further postponement, and we expect works to resume within the next two months," a senior Municipal Administration and Urban Development (MAUD) department official said.

Residents Raise Safety Concerns

Residents say prolonged outages are affecting public safety, especially in the city's peripheral areas. "The stretches between Gopanpally and Kollur, and Vattinagulapally and Osman Nagar, have remained dark for several weeks. Women and senior citizens avoid walking after sunset, while motorists struggle to spot potholes. Despite multiple complaints, the issue remains unresolved," said Ramana Eshwaragiri, president of the Tellapur Neighbourhood Association.

Activists Seek Faster Action

Civic activists have urged the authorities to speed up the tender process instead of waiting for more streetlights to fail. "Large parts of the city remain in darkness because faulty lights are not being replaced. The three municipal corporations must expedite the pending tender before the outages become more widespread," said Harish Daga, a civic activist from Himayatnagar. ]]>
